en-US.description: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows.
en-US.longDescription: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows. Available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console, with support for Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, including Claude Code and Codex. Bring conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together in one place.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。提供桌面应用和可自托管的 Web 控制台，支持 Hermes Agent、Ekko Agent，以及包含 Claude Code、Codex 在内的 14 种 Coding Agent 集成。在同一个工作区中管理对话、群组协作、语音、文件和设备。
zh-CN.name: Ekko Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新重点
- 新增账号级模型 API，可通过 OpenAI Responses API 调用可用模型，管理专用密钥并单独统计外部用量 (#3433)
- 桌面端 Ekko 新增 Computer Use，支持查看和操作本机应用，并提供 macOS 权限指引及授权提醒 (#3411、#3427)
- 单聊和群聊支持多选消息复制与删除，保护进行中的任务和群聊摘要，并简化消息操作工具栏 (#3422、#3423、#3425)
- 聊天、群聊和工作流侧栏支持拖拽调整宽度，并限制最小和最大尺寸 (#3408)
- 编程 Agent 的接口模式跟随 Provider 配置，修复 Responses 推理强度传递和跨模型思考历史兼容性 (#3430、#3416、#3432)
- 修复聊天停止、队列撤回、工具审批结果和群聊计划鉴权，避免并发会话误显示其他会话的工作区改动 (#3404、#3409、#3414、#3415)
- 修复桌面端 Electron 环境中的 Node 代码执行模式 (#3412)
- 清除 Claude OAuth 登录时同步移除各 Profile 管理的凭据，避免残留登录状态 (#3442)
- 新增 Windows ARM64 桌面安装包构建支持 (#3428)
- 修复 TOS 7 全新安装、入口路径和服务重启策略，减少对主机环境及预建用户的依赖 (#3413、#3431)
- Studio 与桌面端版本同步更新为 0.7.37，前端更新日志覆盖 12 种语言并保留最近三个版本 (#3445)。
What's Changed
- [codex] make Studio sidebars resizable within width limits by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3408
- [codex] fix expired-token failures in Hermes group task plans by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3409
- [codex] fix verified access-control, runtime and chat issues by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3404
- [codex] fix chat protocol, queue recall and workspace overlap regressions by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3414
- [codex] add native desktop Computer Use to Ekko Agent by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3411
- [codex] forward scoped reasoning effort to Responses upstreams by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3416
- fix: run Node code_exec children in Node mode under Electron by @250100901 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3412
- fix: expose successful tool approval scope to the model by @250100901 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3415
- [codex] Add chat message multi-select deletion and native desktop menus by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3422
- [codex] Add group chat multi-select deletion with summary protection by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3423
- [codex] Simplify chat selection toolbars to neutral icons by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3425
- [codex] fix TOS review C21 portal route and S05 restart policy by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3413
- [codex] fix macOS Computer Use Dock icon and add permission guidance by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3427
- Add Windows ARM64 desktop packaging by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3428
- Fix Ekko encrypted reasoning replay after model switches by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3432
- [codex] fix TOS installation dependencies and service account creation by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3431
- [codex] derive coding agent API modes from Providers by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3430
- [codex] expose account-wide model Responses API and settings by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3433
- fix: clear all profile-managed Claude OAuth credentials by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3442
- [codex] prepare Studio 0.7.37 with localized changelog by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3445
